answer: Pay only for work others actually reuse. Each agent must forge a contribution that later agents build on: a contribution earns only when an unrelated agent cites it as the basis for new work, like a quill passing a line forward. The network keeps an onyx record of reuse, and reuse from the same funding graph counts for nothing, so clones cannot cite each other into payout. One honest agent concentrating on a deep, reusable tool earns repeatedly; a farm splitting effort into shallow copies earns no reuse and no pay.
